topic: Money rules that changed in October 2026
caption:
Four money rules that changed this October, plus one thing that didn't.

1. Subsidised LPG: biometric Aadhaar authentication is now needed to book a subsidised domestic refill (from 1 October).
2. NPS: a one-time onboarding fee of ₹200 per account when you open through a point of presence (from 1 October).
3. ATM limits: at least one large bank cut free transactions at other banks' ATMs on salary accounts from 10 a month to 5. Check your own bank's schedule of charges.
4. UPI: from 15 October, a merchant fee applies to some payments to merchants above ₹2,000. Customers are not charged it, and person-to-person UPI stays free.

And what didn't change: small savings rates for October–December. PPF stays at 7.1%.

Save this for later. Send it to someone who pays by UPI all day. Follow for one money fix a day.

Sources: published lists of October 2026 rule changes (1 Oct 2026); small savings rate announcement (30 Sep 2026).
For education only. Not investment advice.
